name: Pollen
text: While held, a flower grows from the sand every 8-12 s, 10-18 m away (3 at most, 15 s each); walk into one for 4 times the bees at 1.5 times the speed for 5 s.
vfx: desert flowers on the sand, red bees with red trails while the buff lasts
